milestone: Step 6.5 — Stage C Source Acquisition, License Verification & Ingestion

sources.name: CPython Standard Library (3.12.5)
sources.license_evidence: Official LICENSE file at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/python/cpython/v3.12.5/LICENSE grants nonexclusive, royalty-free worldwide license to analyze, test, distribute, and create derivative works.
sources.redistribution_notes: Preserve Python Software Foundation copyright notice in manifest and data card.

sources.name: TheAlgorithms - Python Implementation Library
sources.license_evidence: Official LICENSE.md at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TheAlgorithms/Python/master/LICENSE.md specifies MIT License (Copyright 2016-2024 The Algorithms).
sources.redistribution_notes: Standard MIT attribution included in data card and manifest.

sources.name: Simple English Wikipedia Official Dump
sources.license_evidence: Wikimedia Foundation Terms of Use: All Wikipedia text is published under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-SA 4.0) and GFDL.
sources.redistribution_notes: Attributed to Wikipedia contributors; compatible with open research and training.

sources.name: Hindi Wikipedia Official Dump
sources.license_evidence: Wikimedia Foundation Terms of Use: Hindi Wikipedia text is published under CC BY-SA 4.0 / GFDL.
sources.redistribution_notes: Attributed to Hindi Wikipedia contributors; subject to Devanagari Unicode preservation.

sources.name: Project Gutenberg & Classical Hindi Public Domain Works
sources.license_evidence: Authored by classical authors (Munshi Premchand, d. 1936) deceased > 60 years ago; published prior to 1950. Public Domain under Indian Copyright Act 1957 Section 22 and US Copyright Law.
sources.redistribution_notes: Public Domain worldwide; free of intellectual property restrictions.

sources.name: GSM8k Grade School Math Reasoning
sources.license_evidence: Official MIT LICENSE file at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openai/grade-school-math/master/LICENSE (Copyright 2021 OpenAI).
sources.redistribution_notes: Standard MIT attribution retained in manifest.

sources.name: OpenStax College Algebra & Calculus Excerpts
sources.license_evidence: Rice University OpenStax Terms: All textbook prose and exercises are released under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License.

sources.name: Sanskrit Classical Canonical Texts (Valmiki Ramayana, Gita, Upanishads)
sources.license_evidence: Composed in ancient India (>2000 years antiquity); public domain worldwide under all international copyright jurisdictions.
sources.redistribution_notes: Unrestricted public domain; preserve Devanagari ligatures and danda punctuation.

sources.name: IIT Bombay English-Hindi Mixed & Transliterated Corpus
sources.license_evidence: CFILT IIT Bombay releases the parallel corpus under non-commercial research license (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0).
sources.redistribution_notes: Non-commercial upstream restriction prohibits inclusion under permissive commercial pre-training terms without explicit bilateral exemption.

sources.name: L3Cube MahaHinglish Conversational Dataset
sources.license_evidence: GitHub repository documentation indicates CC-BY-SA 4.0 licensing, but source data derived from social media Twitter/X comments requiring personal privacy / toxic text scrub.
sources.redistribution_notes: Conditional upon strict PII, @handle, URL, and offensive token filtration.

sources.name: Open Government Data (OGD) Platform India Numerical Sets
sources.license_evidence: Government Open Data License (GODL) published at https://data.gov.in/sites/default/files/Government_Open_Data_License_India.pdf grants royalty-free, perpetual, worldwide right to adapt, publish, and translate data.
sources.redistribution_notes: Attributed to National Informatics Centre / Government of India.

sources.name: Common Crawl Unfiltered / C4 Web Scraping
sources.license_evidence: Lacks explicit copyright authorization from individual content publishers; contains copyrighted books, articles, tracking tokens, and SEO spam.
sources.redistribution_notes: Explicitly barred from ChakrView pre-training under Step 6.4 Corpus Purity Invariant.

sources.name: Books3 / The Pile BookCorpus2
sources.license_evidence: Known infringing dataset derived from Bibliotik; active DMCA takedowns and copyright infringement lawsuits against distributors.
sources.redistribution_notes: Explicitly barred from ChakrView. High legal liability.
